handoff: Review #3: F15-F18 resolved (Norn-Outcome only when a step ends; moved advances, same-step and $stuck carry none; golden 4 cases trailer-only; CI read isolated; cat-file missing handled; commitFor options). All ACs proven. One nit F19: Action.advance type lacks moved.

findings.title: Action.advance type does not declare the new `moved` field
findings.detail:
apply.ts's Advance gains `moved?: true`, and the field now reaches recorded decisions (golden run-rerun-cancel-* hold `advance.moved: true`). Action's `advance` shape in actions.ts, the decide-output contract, still lists only from, outcome, to, counter and reset. Nothing breaks: the trace schema does not type advance, and an older trace without `moved` reads as an outcome edge. The documented contract has drifted, though.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add `moved?: true` (with its doc) to Action.advance in actions.ts.
